content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: tenant-check failure-rate high for tenant 'LuminaHealth' (check: customer-embed-success-rate)

incident-bot: Details: 8m window, 12/120 failures (10%), alert thresh 5% -> page: sev3. Link: https://monitoring.example/r/alert/98765

Alex: I'm on it. Can someone post latest query for failures?

Priya: the quick ES query is: `GET /_search?q=tenant:LuminaHealth AND check:customer-embed-success-rate AND status:fail`

Marco: looks like a spike starting 07:12 UTC. bulk of errors are 502s from embed-proxy-2 pool.

Jenna: support already saw 3 customers message about timeouts. LuminaHealth reported a 10% error rate in their dashboard.

Alex: ok first step: mute the paging rule for LuminaHealth so we stop noisy pages while we triage. Priya, can you add a silence?

Priya: adding silence now for 30m to avoid repeat pages while we investigate. Using: `monitoring-cli silence add --alert-id 98765 --scope tenant:LuminaHealth --duration 30m --reason "Investigating embed proxy 502 spike"`

incident-bot: Silence created (30m) by Priya. Pager suppression in effect.

Marco: I'm attaching a quick stackcheck on embed-proxy-2: `kubectl logs embed-proxy-2 -n prod --since=20m | grep ERROR | head -n 50` prints a lot of upstream EOFs. Possibly transient backend.

Priya: I'm seeing increased latency to model-serving-us-west-2 from that pool. Could be a networking blip or autoscaler thrashing.

Alex: for mitigation: 1) remove embed-proxy-2 from the service LB 2) scale up embed-proxy replicas by +2 3) add a temporary retry in the edge (10s) for LuminaHealth route only. Marco, can you remove node and kick a scale?

Marco: removing embed-proxy-2 from LB: `kubectl patch service embed-proxy -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'` (kidding, doing the actual drain). Draining node now. Scaling to +2 replicas..

Jenna: pinged LuminaHealth with a short note: "we're investigating elevated errors; brief service impact possible, mitigations in progress". Will update them after we stabilize.

Priya: scaled replicas up, and added a temporary route-level retry for LuminaHealth via envoy config: `retries: per_try_timeout: 2s, num_retries: 2` - rolling update applied.

Alex: good. keep silence in place until we confirm baseline. Also we should avoid changing the root alert threshold until we validate it's tenant-specific.

Marco: after drain & scale, errors dropped from 10% -> 1.2% in 6m. Latency also looks normalizing.

incident-bot: Alert resolved (customer-embed-success-rate for LuminaHealth back below threshold). Resolution time: 18m.

Alex: Great. Next: post-incident work. Actions I want tracked:
- Create ENG ticket to add tenant-scoped circuit breaker for embed-proxy errors
- Update monitoring: convert the current check into a per-tenant rolling window and add per-tenant anomaly suppression rule to reduce cross-tenant noise
- Build a small dashboard that shows per-tenant failure %, with quick links to recent deploys and pods
- Revisit paging policy: for checks that are tenant-specific we should page only after 2 windows or after customer-visible errors exceed threshold X

Priya: creating ticket ENG-12567 and assigning to eng-runtime. I'll add notes and the es query/example.

Jenna: also recommending a short runbook snippet for Support: how to check embed-proxy status and what to tell customers. I'll author that.

Marco: for monitoring specifics, propose: change alert to trigger pages when tenant failure-rate > 5% AND affected_requests > 50 in 10m. That should filter out small noisy tenants.

Alex: agree. Do it as a staged rollout: create new alert variant (non-paging) for 24h, observe noise reduction, then migrate to paging rule. Also create the dashboard.

Priya: I'll add a temp rule and link: https://monitoring.example/editor?alert=new-per-tenant

incident-bot: Note: silence will expire in ~12m.

Alex: Leave silence until we validate the new alert variant is catching same signal. We'll manually unmute later.

Jenna: Postmortem note: customer impact minor but could have become major if embed errors continued. I'll open a CS ticket for LuminaHealth with the timeline.

Marco: putting small k8s postmortem snippet in ENG-12567 (node drain + pod restart timings).

Priya: flagged the alert noise metric to eng-sre for threshold tuning in next week's oncall rotation.

Alex: thanks everyone. Closing the page; follow ups assigned to ENG-12567 (runtime), CS-4321 (customer comms), DOCS-99 (support runbook).

incident-bot: Thread closed by Alex.
